samples.stimulus: In the pie chart shown, each section represents one category of the main way the employees of a company travel to work. The size of each section is labeled as a percent of the whole. 192 of the employees are in the category "Car". The pie chart contains the data needed for this question.
samples.question: How many of the employees are in the categories "Bicycle" and "Carpool" combined?
samples.explanation: (1) 원그래프에서 각 부채꼴의 값을 읽는다: Train 20%, Carpool 10%, Car 40%, Bicycle 30%. (2) Car 는 40% 이고 192 이다. (3) 전체 = 192 ÷ 0.4 = 480 이다. (4) Bicycle + Carpool = 40% 이다. (5) 480 × 0.4 = 192 이다. (6) 따라서 답은 192 이다. 따라서 정답은 192이다.
